info.name: FDX V6.0.0 Account Information Account Statements API

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Account identifier, found in the `GET /accounts` endpoint response.
Plaid expects the ID to be a different value from the account number

**Note:** If the status of the `accountId` provided is `RESTRICTED`, you can send a 200 response with an empty body to indicate that no payment networks are available at this time.

params.name: offset
params.description: An opaque ID that indicates there is at least one more page of data available. This value does not need to be numeric or have any specific pattern. If provided, Plaid will use this value to send a new request and retrieve the next page. Omitting this value indicates that there is no more data to retrieve.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of elements that the API consumer wishes to receive. Plaid has a default limit of 100 elements. If your organization has a different limit, use the lower limit to determine how many items to send per page. To retrieve multiple pages, Plaid will use the opaque `nextOffset` field to send a subsequent request until the `nextOffset` is no longer included.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start time for use in retrieval of elements (ISO 8601). When used with the `/transactions` endpoint, Plaid filters by the `postedTimestamp`.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End time for use in retrieval of elements (ISO 8601). When used with the `/transactions` endpoint, Plaid filters by the `postedTimestamp`.

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Account identifier, found in the `GET /accounts` endpoint response.
Plaid expects the ID to be a different value from the account number

**Note:** If the status of the `accountId` provided is `RESTRICTED`, you can send a 200 response with an empty body to indicate that no payment networks are available at this time.

params.name: statementId
params.description: Statement identifier, found in the `GET /accounts/{accountId}/statements` endpoint response
